main.description: A public offer by a seller. Describes stable facts about the thing offered. Dynamic stock state lives in app.temp.commerce.inventory, temporary price rules in app.temp.commerce.promotion.

structure.description: Structural dimension. Absent means 'simple'. 'variant' requires partOf; 'grouped' requires groupedItems.

fulfillmentKind.description: Delivery-kind dimension. Required unless partOf is set, in which case it is inherited from the productGroup.

purchase.description: Purchase-mechanism dimension: how a consumer proceeds from discovery to purchase. Absent means no purchase path is advertised.

title.description: Required unless partOf is set, in which case it is inherited from the productGroup when absent.

description.description: Inherited from the productGroup when absent and partOf is set.

shortDescription.description: One-line summary for cards and feeds. Without it every application truncates the long description differently.

price.description: Normal/base offer price, before any promotion. Promotions are separate records and never rewrite this value.

category.description: Coarse category. Required unless partOf is set, in which case it is inherited from the productGroup.

classifications.description: Detailed classification in external, independently versioned taxonomies. A listing may participate in several at once. Inherited from the productGroup when absent and partOf is set.

specifications.description: Structured product properties. Inherited from the productGroup when absent and partOf is set.

brand.description: Inherited from the productGroup when absent and partOf is set.

identifiers.description: External product identifiers (GTIN, ISBN, MPN). Usable by indexers as a cross-seller join key without a canonical catalog layer.

images.description: Inherited from the productGroup when absent and partOf is set.

shopRef.description: AT URI of the parent shop record

partOf.description: AT URI of the parent productGroup, if this listing is a variant

variantProperties.description: Concrete variant property tuple (e.g. [{axis: Color, value: Red}, {axis: Size, value: M}]). A property with no value spans every value on that axis.

groupedItems.description: The listings this one bundles together. Present exactly when structure is 'grouped'. The grouped listing publishes its own price: per-item discount overrides are deliberately absent, because two applications totalling prices held in other records can disagree and both be right.

location.description: Where this item is, when it differs from the shop's location — a pickup-only sofa in a shop that otherwise ships. Absent means fall back to the shop's location. This is an intrinsic fact about the item; delivery methods and destinations belong to app.temp.commerce.fulfillmentProfile.

details.description: Intrinsic facts specific to a fulfillment kind. Physical properties are first-class fields, not a union member.

catalogVisibility.description: Where the listing should surface: 'visible' in both browse and search, 'catalog' in browse only, 'search' in search only, 'hidden' in neither while staying reachable by direct link. Open/advisory knownValues. Distinct from hideFromFriends, which is social privacy rather than catalogue placement.

hideFromFriends.description: Social privacy: hide this listing from friends/followers. Distinct from catalogVisibility, which controls browse and search placement.

soldIndividually.description: The seller asks that no more than one be bought per order. Advisory: checkout is outside this protocol, so nothing here can enforce a basket rule.

reviewsAllowed.description: False if the seller does not want reviews. Advisory, and weaker than it looks: reviews are buyer-owned records in the buyer's own repo, so no field here can prevent one from existing. It is a request to applications, not enforcement.

externalPurchase.description: Purchase completes on an external site (e.g. a marketplace or the seller's own storefront)

buttonText.description: Label for the call to action, so it reads 'Buy on Etsy' rather than something generic. Naming the destination is what keeps an external purchase from feeling like a dead end.

checkoutPurchase.description: Purchase begins at a checkout endpoint the seller controls. This schema describes the entry point only; checkout, payment, and reservation are transactional concerns outside the protocol.

buttonText.description: Label for the call to action

informational.description: The listing advertises an offer but is not directly purchasable — e.g. contact-for-quote, or a catalog entry sold offline

serviceDetails.description: Intrinsic fields for services and commissions

digitalDetails.description: Terms of sale for a digital good — what the buyer needs to know before buying, which is why they sit on the public listing rather than in a transaction system. Usage rights (commercial use, seats, territory) are a licensing question, not a delivery one, and are deliberately absent.

fileFormats.description: File formats delivered (e.g. PNG, SVG, AI). An array because an asset pack is several at once.

downloadLimit.description: How many times the buyer may download. -1 means unlimited.

downloadExpiryDays.description: Days after purchase that the download stays available. -1 means it never expires.

deliveryMethod.description: How the digital good is delivered. No file URL: this record is public, and publishing the location gives the product away.
